# Sadeem Robotics

> SADEEM is an autonomous service robot built by Sadeem Robotics. It navigates on its own — no remote, no track, no operator — to deliver items, guide visitors, and assist staff in hotels, hospitals, museums, retail, and corporate venues.

Sadeem Robotics is a real, operating company developing proprietary autonomous mobile robot (AMR) technology. SADEEM has been demonstrated on real venue floors handling delivery, guidance, and greeting tasks without human remote control.
